verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a broad API covering many runtime operations. It can create, read and update records, launch and bulk-launch workflows, push or block approvals, read and update contract documents, run data exports, and fully manage webhooks, which the docs say can be handled in both the UI and the API. Its own docs also show key tasks that stay UI-only: workflows must be designed and published in Workflow Designer before the API can launch them, clickwrap workflows must be created and published first, and API access requires a separate add-on whose OAuth clients are registered in the app. Missing for 10: API-based workflow and template design and publishing, programmatic setup of clickwrap workflows and OAuth clients, an explicit UI-API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent confirmation of parity.
